summary: An OpenAI researcher states that GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra, a model publicly available today, produced a proof of a 50-year-old math conjecture.

mechanisms.reason: The post claims a publicly available model produced a proof of a long-standing unsolved math conjecture, which if accurate is a step-change demonstration of a new task class.
mechanisms.quote: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra produced a proof of a 50 year old math conjecture.

practices.reason: If a publicly available model can independently produce mathematical proofs of unsolved conjectures, that changes what tasks the model could be trusted with in research workflows, but the claim is unreplicated and comes from the lab's own researcher.

notable_reason: A claim that a publicly available model produced a novel proof of a 50-year-old math conjecture is an extraordinary capability claim worth surfacing even though it is unverified and stated informally.
